summary: Part 3 (10:20-14:12) of the 2.0 Fulfillment App (Sellers) video. Pierre covers what happens when Revibe rejects seller stock at quality check (bulk rejection of everything vs. partial return to supplier), how Inventory exits records returns, sales and aging returns, how to drop prices by 2% in Supplier inventory, and how to request boxes in the Box request page. All 40 frames were opened. Several narration timestamps do not match the screens shown: the Supplier inventory screen is on screen at 11:36, the aging rows appear at 13:10 (not 13:05), and the Box request page appears at 14:03 (not 13:49). RTO, the orders app and the single-device price drop are not explained in this part.

unclear.issue: Trainer names an app for sales ('{orders?} app') but the name is low-confidence and the app is not shown in this part. Do not state where sales are found beyond 'Inventory exits Sale rows'.

Narration words '{ala?}' and '{there?}' are low-confidence, so the exact wording of the quantity rule is unclear. The screen supports a difference of one on the visible rows (fact stated at medium confidence).

Trainer says a single device can be dropped by entering the device ('enter like this in the device'), but no per-device Drop control is visible in the frames. Only the selection and bulk Drop -2% path is shown.
Trainer does not say when the 20-day count starts (listing date, sale date or another date).
Trainer refers to 'Third option' and to earlier options that are not in this part of the video.
RTO rows appear in Inventory exits (Quantity before 0, after 1 on most rows), but the term RTO and its process are not explained in this part.
Narration says the form 'will generate an automated ID'. The screen shows an ID value 0d88444d, but the generation step is not shown, so the mechanism is not confirmed.

Narration introduces the Box request section at 13:49, but the frame at that time (t00829) still shows Inventory exits with the pointer on the Box request menu item. The Box request page and form appear at 14:03 (t00843).

Narration about aging inventory returns starts at 13:05, but the frame at 13:05 (t00785) still shows Supplier inventory with the pointer on the Inventory exits menu item. The SK World aging rows first appear at 13:10 (t00790).
Narration about selling devices starts at 11:49, but t00708 and t00712 show Supplier inventory and Return to supplier rows. The Sale group first appears at t00714 (11:54).
